### Requirement: design_path is read and its matching design.md section forms part of the...

The system SHALL ensure that design_path is read and its matching design.md section forms part of the state, covered by a test using a package fixture.

WHEN `judge-implementation-strategy-selection-in-autopilot` is implemented
THEN design_path is read and its matching design.md section forms part of the state, covered by a test using a package fixture.

### Requirement: The vendor-count gate still forces lead_review when fewer than three vendors...

The system SHALL ensure that the vendor-count gate still forces lead_review when fewer than three vendors are available, regardless of the judged label.

#### Scenario: The vendor-count gate still forces lead_review when fewer than three vendors...

WHEN `judge-implementation-strategy-selection-in-autopilot` is implemented
THEN The vendor-count gate still forces lead_review when fewer than three vendors are available, regardless of the judged label.

The system SHALL ensure that the existing weighted-sum selector remains reachable as the fallback and its current tests pass unchanged.

#### Scenario: The existing weighted-sum selector remains reachable as the fallback and its...

WHEN `judge-implementation-strategy-selection-in-autopilot` is implemented
